# Behavioral Nudges Prevent Loan Delinquencies at Scale: A 13-Million-Person Field Experiment

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Robert Kuan, Kristin Blagg, Benjamin L. Castleman, Rajeev Darolia, Jordan D. Matsudaira, Katherine L. Milkman, Lesley J. Turner  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences  
**DOI:** [10.1073/pnas.2416708122](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2416708122)

**Keywords:** behavioral nudges, student loans, field experiment, delinquency, education finance

## Abstract

13-million-person field experiment with US Department of Education testing behaviorally-informed emails to help student loan borrowers. Redesigned emails reduce delinquencies by 0.42 percentage points.
